introHtml: Custom 23 oz bistro mugs offer a generous capacity that suits hearty coffee drinkers and tea lovers alike. This larger size is ideal for cafes wanting to serve sizable portions or for corporate break rooms where refills are less frequent. Made from durable ceramic, these mugs provide a sturdy feel and excellent heat retention. Decorate them with your logo using full-color imprint or classic engraving for a premium look that stands out on any countertop.
